comment: M074 visual-diff matrix. Optional per screen: `threshold` / `maxDiffPixelRatio` override the defaults; `mask` is a list of CSS selectors painted over before comparing (animated/live regions); a top-level `mask` applies to every screen. Changing a mask changes the baseline images of that screen: re-accept it on the runner. Screens x states x scheme; the viewport comes from the Playwright project (desktop 1440, tablet 1024, mobile 390). `sources` are repo-relative path prefixes: the touched-only mode runs a screen when a changed file starts with one of them. `shared` prefixes touch every screen.

stateKinds.ready: the screen as loaded in demo mode (no backend), clock fixed, performance:full
stateKinds.dialog: a representative sw-dialog (heading, field, footer buttons) opened over the screen
stateKinds.panels: every sw-state-panel state (loading, empty, error, forbidden, stale, partial) in a fixed grid over the screen
